rationale: No supported optimization can be applied while preserving intended coverage and verified prerequisites. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true) matches the visible matrix (fail-fast: false), but cancelling remaining matrix cells on failure would reduce test coverage across the CRDB versions and make the downstream test_results job's report aggregation incomplete, since it depends on test and runs if: always() to collect all report-*-artifacts; this conflicts with preserving full build/test coverage and full failure diagnostics. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) cannot be verified because dependency installation occurs inside the opaque local action ./.github/actions/test-runner and no lockfile or cache path is visible in the workflow, so the cache-input precondition is unconfirmed. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already satisfied by the existing concurrency block with cancel-in-progress: true. Remaining patterns are not applicable (no schedule triggers, no Bazel) or are ci_service/build_configuration concerns rather than verifiable workflow_yaml changes for this file.
